name.message: Hide Upgrade Button for Gmail, Drive & Docs

description.message: 隐藏 Gmail、Google 云端硬盘和 Google 文档中的 Upgrade 和 Ask Gemini 按钮，以及 Google 日历中的 Upgrade 按钮

popup_toggle_gemini_label.message: 隐藏 Ask Gemini 按钮
popup_toggle_gemini_label.description: Label of the Ask Gemini toggle.

popup_calendar_access_label.message: 在 Google 日历中启用
popup_calendar_access_label.description: Label of the optional Google Calendar access toggle in the popup; also the enable button on the onboarding page.

popup_markup_note.message: 如果按钮再次出现，说明 Google 更改了界面——修复将随扩展程序更新推出。
popup_markup_note.description: Popup note explaining that Google interface changes are fixed by extension updates.

popup_report_link.description: Popup link to the issue tracker.

popup_onboarding_link.description: Popup link that opens the onboarding page.

onboarding_title.description: Onboarding page title and heading, shown after installation.

onboarding_intro.message: Upgrade 和 Ask Gemini 按钮现已在 Gmail、Google 云端硬盘、文档、表格和幻灯片中隐藏。无需重新加载已打开的标签页。
onboarding_intro.description: Onboarding lead line under the title.

onboarding_before.description: Onboarding illustration label above the Google header with the buttons still shown.

onboarding_after.description: Onboarding illustration label above the Google header with the buttons hidden.

onboarding_how_image_alt.message: Google 顶部栏前后对比：Upgrade 和 Ask Gemini 按钮已消失
onboarding_how_image_alt.description: Accessible description of the before/after illustration.

onboarding_calendar_heading.description: Onboarding card heading about optional Google Calendar support.

onboarding_calendar_text.message: 也隐藏其中的 Upgrade 按钮。浏览器会请求您允许访问 calendar.google.com。
onboarding_calendar_text.description: Onboarding Calendar card text while Calendar access is off.

onboarding_calendar_text_on.message: 其中的 Upgrade 按钮也已隐藏。
onboarding_calendar_text_on.description: Onboarding Calendar card text once Calendar access is granted.

onboarding_calendar_why_toggle.description: Onboarding disclosure toggle that reveals why Calendar access is optional.

onboarding_calendar_why.message: 日历访问权限只向需要的用户申请。如果将其设为必需，浏览器会为所有已安装本扩展程序的用户停用它，直到他们批准新的访问权限。
onboarding_calendar_why.description: Onboarding: text revealed by the 'Why is it optional?' toggle.

onboarding_calendar_enabled.description: Onboarding status shown when Google Calendar access is granted.

onboarding_calendar_disable.description: Onboarding button that removes Google Calendar access.

onboarding_calendar_denied.message: 未获得访问权限。您可以随时重试。
onboarding_calendar_denied.description: Onboarding hint shown after the user declined or closed the browser's Calendar access prompt.

onboarding_pin_heading.description: Onboarding card heading about pinning the extension to the toolbar.

onboarding_pin_text.message: 打开工具栏中拼图形状的“扩展程序”菜单，固定 Hide Upgrade Button，以后只需点击一下即可打开其设置。
onboarding_pin_text.description: Onboarding: how to pin the extension icon. Keep 'Hide Upgrade Button' untranslated.

onboarding_pin_done.description: Onboarding status shown when the extension icon is already pinned to the toolbar.

onboarding_pin_done_text.message: 点击工具栏中的扩展程序图标即可打开设置。
onboarding_pin_done_text.description: Onboarding Pin card text once the extension icon is pinned.

onboarding_report_link.message: 按钮又出现了？报告问题
onboarding_report_link.description: Onboarding footer link to report a hidden button that reappeared.

onboarding_rate_link.message: 觉得有用？请在应用商店中为本扩展程序评分
onboarding_rate_link.description: Onboarding unobtrusive link to the extension's store page.

onboarding_privacy_text.message: 无数据分析，无网络请求。

onboarding_privacy_link.description: Onboarding link to the privacy policy.
